name: Destiny Weaver: raid creatures keep their level for a character with scaling on
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1 and DestinyWeaver.Scaling.Offset=3. Raids are
scaled for the group by content scaling and the raid difficulty modules; a per-character view on top would
scale the same creature twice. Molten Core (409) is a raid: a level-60 character with scaling on is shown a
level-50 Mindless Zombie (1501, the fixture the destiny-weaver-scaling scenario uses) at its own level, not
lifted to 57 as in the open world.

steps.label: Scaling on leaves a raid creature at its own level
and tells the client that level
